examples.scenario: Attackers compromise the update mechanism of a popular open-source JavaScript library by injecting malicious code into its NPM package update, causing downstream applications to execute a remote code execution payload when the compromised dependency is installed or updated.

examples.detection_method: Automated SBOM and dependency auditing tools detect unexpected postinstall scripts and new files in package updates; code signing validation fails since the new package was not signed or signature mismatch; network monitoring alerts on HTTP connections to known malicious domains during build or install; Git repository hooks and CI pipeline enforce no arbitrary scripts in dependency packages; threat intelligence platforms flag malicious-actor.com domain and URL patterns; static code analysis flags usage of child_process.exec with remote payload fetching.
